title: Stripe
description: Connect the tenant's Stripe account, watch its events and fix incidents.
connectHint: Open the onboarding link, then refresh the connection.
directHint: The secret key is sent once and never returned.
urlsHint: Where Stripe may send a customer back after checkout. Exact URLs, https only.
notConnected: Stripe is not connected for this tenant yet.
connectIntro: Card payments and top-ups go through the tenant's own Stripe account. Choose how to connect it.
connectOnboardingHint: Stripe hosts the sign-up and verification; the tenant returns here when done.
connectKeysHint: For an account the tenant already runs; the secret key is sent once and never shown again.
secretMissing: No webhook signing secret is set, so Stripe events cannot be verified. Add it from the Stripe dashboard.
